brand.name: Must Power
brand.notes: OEM is Must Energy (Guangdong) Technology Co., Ltd., Foshan/Shenzhen, China; the brand is also written MUST, Must Energy or Must Power, and older manuals print the legacy name Shenzhen Must Energy Technology Co., Ltd. Must is the OEM behind several Pakistani-facing brands and product lines, including the PV1800/PH1800 hybrids sold in Pakistan by Must Power Energy (Lahore) - a PEC-registered Pakistani company and the sole Pakistan distributor for MUST Energy.
